purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Mathioya Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image (after correcting the page's own 180 degree scan orientation). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (MATHIOYA, code 105, county MURANG'A code 021) was cross-checked against the governed official source_url and form_id, and against the visible I.E.B.C. Constituency Returning Officer stamp and signature dated 11-08-2022 on the same page, before this row was accepted.
